notes: Pure control case. Proves the detector does not report healthy before a full baseline window exists, and does not drift into degraded on its own under constant, low-variance RTT. If an implementation reports anything other than unknown before 60s or anything other than healthy after it, that is a bug in baseline-window accounting, not a threshold-tuning issue.
